headline: Daily Activity 500
title: Daily Activity | Skip one task and still win | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Aniimo Daily Activity has seven hundred points up for grabs, but you only need five hundred. At five hundred, all five reward packs unlock, including an Incredible Egg, Aniipod Hyper, Growth Fruits and Glimmer. Log in is worth one hundred. Spending sixty Primegy is worth two hundred. So you can skip one small task. It resets at four AM server time. Have you claimed yours today? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Daily Activity guide: 500 of the 700 daily points unlock all five reward packs, including an Incredible Egg, Aniipod Hyper and Glimmer. Resets at 4 AM server time.
